requirements.requirement_ja: 証明付きの値・混合戦略と未解決の区別
requirements.finding_ja: 実装・独立計算の対照を通過。全応手への損失保証と圧縮後の方策を検証。

requirements.requirement_ja: 全情報の着手・探索の葉へ実際に接続
requirements.finding_ja: 1対1～2対2、混合の一度限りの抽選、fallback、誤方策の修正と正方策の維持を検証。独立標本での誤り修正は0件。

requirements.requirement_ja: 公開情報だけを使うblind接続と各入口の整合
requirements.finding_ja: 観測・beliefからの仮説値を利用。隠れた真の状態変更への不変性、通常・解析・継続対局を検証。公開経路の全情報ルート採用は0。
requirements.conditional_followup: An information-set subgame was conditional on observed full-information gains disappearing under blind evaluation; neither independent condition established gains.

requirements.requirement_ja: 予算・キャッシュ・未解決分類と費用改善
requirements.finding_ja: 共有予算、小バッチ、正確な状態キー、上限を検証。全情報の局面間再利用あり、公開/Wasmでは判断ごとにリセット。性能改善の通過条件は未達。
limitations: Public/Wasm solver caches are decision-scoped; across-decision reachable-cache reuse is implemented only in the full-information agent.
A final indivisible probe can overrun the nominal solver share; measured overruns are retained.
More useful guarantees at lower cost and a strength gain at unchanged wait were not established.

requirements.requirement_ja: 事前固定した独立終盤・開発・Web確認評価
requirements.finding_ja: 400開発局・288独立継続局・1,200確認局を完了。18元対局／600ペアで区間推定。得点・区間下端・平均待ち・メモリの採用条件に失敗。
limitations: Fixed timing calibration failed to achieve equal observed nonforced mean wait; no exact matched-time causal effect is claimed.
The Web candidate includes a public-information path change; native OFF arms and independent ON/OFF holdout results are reported separately.
No score-based early stop, retuning, extension or pooling was used.

requirements.requirement_ja: 回帰検証・採否と結果の保存
requirements.finding_ja: native・Wasm・実worker・Web buildが成功。不採用分岐の結果と失敗箇所を保存。公開既定値は維持、デプロイは採用案がないため対象外。
requirements.deployment: Not applicable: the fixed candidate failed adoption gates; no publication or deployment performed.

interpretation: The plan explicitly permits completion by evaluating the actual integrated method and recording rejection and failure points. This audit does not claim that the optimization targets or every prospective optimization were achieved.
